posts.title: Hugo, Don't Waste Your Time
posts.description: Hugo , the static site generator written in Go, is fast and has been around for years. However, the software has been in a constant prototype phase for over a decade. In 2026, the development is still operating on a methodology of “move fast and break things.” That’s fine for a six-month startup, but less-so for a platform that has been around since 2013. posts.title: Caddy Server stops working
posts.description: Over the holidays a web server ran out of hard drive space. So I rebooted the system to clear out the temporary directory tmp/ to restore some space. Unbeknownst to me, Caddy ran out of space in the middle of writing to its internal cache and would not start .
